title: xDrip ignores battery voltage warning level adjustments for G7
body:
This is what the status page shows.  
![Screenshot_20231123-100421](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/assets/51497406/49182a8f-b3c2-46ac-a213-1a6dc5a30685)

I just changed the settings.
![Screenshot_20231123-100658](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/assets/51497406/3c18b142-50ce-4c62-b44d-d9eac891ef45)

After the next reading, the setting is automatically changed back to 280.

comments.body:
xDrip voltage B warning level is currently preliminary.  
This PR will lower it to a more accurate value:  https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/pull/3239

After that PR is merged, voltage B on your status page will not be red.

If it is, please inform us by opening a discussions or by posting here in this issue, and we will further adjust it if/when needed.
The hope is that there will be no need to customize the level.  The customization has intentionally been disabled.
